name: nucleos-take-home
description: Khan Academy onboarding script + MV3 auto sign-in extension (Nucleos SSE take-home)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/*.zip && (cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/khan-academy-auto-signin-extension.zip . -x config.local.json -x ".*") && git archive --format=zip --prefix=nucleos-take-home/ -o dist/nucleos-take-home-source.zip HEAD
